newsitem.title: CANADA: Balaclava says BC Sugar bid proceeding.
newsitem.headline: Balaclava says BC Sugar bid proceeding.

text.p: Balaclava Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday the bid by its subsidiary Balaclava Acquisition Inc for 7.85 million common shares of BC Sugar Refinery Ltd at a price of C$15 per share is proceeding as planned.
The bid is set to expire at 1930 EDT/2330 GMT on May 30.

Balaclava said it will apply to the Ontario Securities Commission to issue an order cease-trading any rights that might become issuable under BC Sugar's poison pill, so that Balaclava will be able to take up and pay for common shares deposited under the offer.

"We are getting excellent support from shareholders for our bid which indicates to us that many shareholders see it as financially superior to the potential bid of Great Pacific Acquisition Inc for all of the shares, which is indicated to be at C$14.75 per share," Balaclava President Stuart Belkin said.

BC Sugar said earlier this month it agreed to a C$14.75 per share takeover bid by Great Pacific, conditional on 50.1 percent acceptance of the offer. It said the Great Pacific bid was financially superior to the partial bid of Balaclava and recommended shareholders not tender their shares to the Balaclava offer.
